entities.name: PMID:25445232
observations: 2015 Clinical Biochemistry cross-sectional study examined fasting serum DPP-4 activity and ALT in adults with type 1 diabetes.

entities.name: Type 1 diabetes mellitus
observations: The study cohort included 44 adults aged 18–65 years with type 1 diabetes.

entities.name: DPP-4 activity
observations: Fasting serum enzymatic activity was measured spectrophotometrically.

entities.name: DPP-4 activity and ALT
observations: In 44 adults with type 1 diabetes, fasting serum DPP-4 activity correlated positively with ALT (r=0.364, p=0.015); the association remained significant after adjustment (p=0.025) for age, gender, diabetes duration, statin use, and antihypertensive use. Adjusted effect size and confidence interval were not reported in the abstract; cross-sectional design limits causal inference.
